02 · What We Know

What we know about TMNA

Application and Legacy Systems Modernization
01Application Modernization
  • 1,300 apps not yet modernized on Chofer
  • No documentation for apps off platform
  • Blueprint v2 release
02Monolith-to-microservices
  • 100,000+ scheduled ETL scripts across thousands of databases
  • ~12,000 lines of Terraform per Blueprint
  • 3 copies of data across mainframe
03Legacy code refactor & migration
  • 40M+ lines COBOL→Java, quality scored 3.44/5
  • 1979 mainframe still runs 90% of supply chain
  • No test coverage on the translated output
